summary.headline: Astrological Chapter Catalogue
summary.text: Catalog of Florentine codex chapters on lunar configurations and phases, single-degree terms, weather signs and meteors, zodiacal and stellar significations, hourly signs, zodiacal outcomes, decanal faces, and military inquiries concerning armies and besieged cities. Cross-references include codex 12, Hephaestio II, Maximus and Ammon, and Paulus Alexandrinus.
